title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Google launches a unified Gemini enterprise agent with its own Workspace identity, subagents and MCP support
bullets.summary: Announced Oct 8 at a Google Cloud event: an agent that takes objectives, delegates to subagents, runs multi-day jobs, connects to Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Jira and any MCP server, lets users pick models including Claude, and logs actions in an agent-attributed audit trail; business-first, no price given.
bullets.how: The Construct: closest public analogue to our agent-with-own-identity architecture and a validation of MCP as the connector layer; benchmark its tasks-inbox and audit trail against ours. PRAGMA: competitor/partner pattern for client AI-operator offers. Brand 9 Signs: no direct use yet.

bullets.title: Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5 — ~75% cheaper, first Haiku with effort controls
bullets.summary: Launched Oct 7: $0.10/$0.50 per 1M tokens under 100k context (was $1/$5), 72.4% on OSWorld 2.1 computer-use subset (Haiku 4.5: 15.7%), beta computer/browser-use in the Python and TypeScript SDKs; model ID claude-haiku-5-5.
bullets.how: The Construct: make it the default cheap worker for high-volume steps (compaction, browser use, DB queries, routine scans like this one). Brand 9 Signs: low-cost customer-support / quote-intake agent. PRAGMA: cuts per-client run cost for AI-operator builds.

bullets.title: Claude Cowork scheduled tasks and new sessions moved to the cloud for Pro/Max (Oct 6)
bullets.summary: The 'Only on this computer' option was removed; new Cowork tasks run in the cloud, scheduled tasks move to the cloud, and tasks touching local files need the desktop app open (per a third-party write-up; Anthropic's own notice not independently checked).
bullets.how: The Construct: this routine already runs cloud-side, so audit every scheduled task that depends on Mac-local files or launchd handoff and confirm the desktop app/bridge stays up. PRAGMA: a real deployment caveat to flag for clients on local-first agent setups.

bullets.title: Mistral unveils Large 4 — public release set for Oct 27
bullets.summary: Mistral's CEO says Large 4 beats several Chinese open-weight rivals in some areas (vendor claim, per Reuters); public release scheduled October 27.
bullets.how: The Construct: add to the worker-model bake-off once weights/API land. PRAGMA: possible EU-hosted or self-host option for privacy-sensitive clients. Brand 9 Signs: no direct use.

bullets.title: AgentR releases open-source Webcmd — browser infrastructure so agents learn a website once and reuse it
bullets.summary: Free open-source tool announced Oct 9 that lets AI agents record how a site works and reuse that knowledge later instead of re-exploring each run.
bullets.how: The Construct: could cut cost/flakiness of browser-driven workers (e.g., Hermes web tasks); trial before adopting. Brand 9 Signs: possible for repeat vendor-portal chores. PRAGMA: reusable pattern for client web automations.

praxis_lesson: Every major platform is converging on the same agent shape — own identity, subagent delegation, MCP connectors, audit trail — while model prices collapse (Haiku 5.5) and runtimes move to the cloud (Cowork): differentiate on your operating discipline and data, not the plumbing, and route high-volume steps to the cheapest capable model.
